summary: Ran full backend architecture suites (execution_components + execution_spine + portal_operational), reproduced 5 fixture-migration failures, updated only test fixtures, and reran to green.

critical_code_review_comments: The prior failing cases were fixture drift, not runtime regression: monkeypatch targeted removed execution_composition.read_view symbol and bypassed typed authority context contract.
advance_execution unit test used request=object() and failed before the intended concealment/authz boundary due missing request.app.state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 30 resolved exactly the 5 expected fixture migrations. Full target suites now pass. UI unchanged; desktop smoke load succeeded from external preview URL with no visible error selectors.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: pytest across three suites returned 135 passed / 5 failed. Root causes were test harness mismatches after typed native authority migration: (1) execution_spine supplemental test patched removed symbol execution_composition.read_view and used obsolete dict shape {'licence_admitted': true} instead of typed LicencePortalView with allowance_state and valid principal/control context; (2) portal_operational scope unit passed request=object(), triggering AttributeError on request.app.state before 404 concealment assertion. Mitigation: updated fixtures only—monkeypatch execution_authority.read_view + require_control_scope + synthetic PrincipalV1/org lookup; supplied request namespace with app.state.execution_bindings in scope test. Runtime behavior unchanged and OPERATION_AUTHORITY_NOT_BOUND / foreign 404 assertions preserved.
